description: Create a buy order for ENERGY/BANDWIDTH delegated to `orderReceiver`. SPENDS FUNDS — confirm the plan with the user first. Inputs: `orderResourceType`, `orderReceiver`, `orderUnitPrice` (SUN, not TRX), `orderDurationSec`, `orderResourceAmount`, `paymentPaymentAmount` (SUN), and `paymentMethod`: `internal` — debits the TronSave internal balance (needs an api-key login/header or a signature login whose wallet has an internal account); `onchain` — no login needed, but `paymentSignedTx` must be the user's wallet-signed TRX transfer to `systemDepositAddress`. Take price/amount/duration values from the latest `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`. Returns `{ success, message, code, data.orderId }` — check `success`; verify with `tronsave_get_order` or `tronsave_list_orders`. Not idempotent: on a timeout, verify before retrying to avoid duplicate orders.

orderDurationSec.description: Delegation duration in seconds. Must match the `durationSec` used in `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`.

orderReceiver.description: TRON base58 address (starts with T) that receives delegated resource. Same as `receiver` passed to `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`.

orderResourceAmount.description: Amount of ENERGY or BANDWIDTH units to purchase. Same as `buyResourceAmount` in estimate when applicable.

orderResourceType.description: Resource to buy: ENERGY (smart contracts) or BANDWIDTH (transactions). Must match `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`.

orderUnitPrice.description: Unit price in SUN per resource unit (NOT TRX). Use `unitPrice` from the latest `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` for the same receiver, amount, and duration.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method for this order: `onchain` (wallet signed tx) or `internal` (internal balance).

paymentPaymentAmount.description: Total payment in SUN (1 TRX = 1e6 SUN). Use `estimateTrx` (SUN) from the latest `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`.

paymentSignedTx.description: Required when `paymentMethod=onchain`: the user's wallet-signed TRX transfer of `paymentPaymentAmount` SUN to `systemDepositAddress` (from `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`), TronWeb shape `{ txID, raw_data, raw_data_hex, signature[] }`. Must be produced client-side by the user's wallet; never fabricate or hand-edit.

raw_data.description: Raw transaction body produced by TronWeb (`raw_data`).

contract.description: At least one TRON contract entry; shape varies by contract type.

signature.description: Wallet signatures over `raw_data_hex`; usually a single hex string (130 chars for 65-byte secp256k1).

txID.description: Transaction hash (64 hex chars, lowercase, no `0x` prefix).

visible.description: Whether addresses inside `raw_data.contract` are base58 (`true`) vs hex (`false`).
